summary: Iter 71 — Print Sell Factor feature end-to-end test. Backend: 10/10 pytests PASS (admin API surface, GM% math parity at factor 0 / 1.0 / 1.2, non-admin 403, unprinted & unrelated-tier isolation, multi-part per-component delta). Frontend: Admin → PRINT SELL FACTOR tab present between SELL CURVE and GRADE ADDERS, 9 rows rendered in correct MSF order (0-1 → 100+), 1-3 save → OVERRIDE badge visible, reset → baseline. GM CURVE tab also sorted in MSF order (regression ok). ONE BUG FOUND: run_estimate() in /app/backend/engine/runner.py does NOT surface printSellFactor / printSell at the top level of its return dict (even though pricing.py L272 does). This means (a) GET /api/engine/calculate-all response is missing these fields on the per-slot row, and (b) multi-part slots[i].perComponent[j] rows have no printSellFactor/printSell keys (because they spread run_estimate output). The ACTUAL ITEM SELL MATH is wired correctly — itemSell delta vs factor and vs printDirect matches the formula within $0.05 for both single and multi-part, and unprinted / other-tier items are provably unaffected. Only the diagnostic fields are missing from the API surface. Rate overrides left at defaults (0 active).

minor.issue: run_estimate() in engine/runner.py does not forward printSellFactor and printSell from the pricing dict → fields are absent in calculate-all response and always 0 in calculate-multi-part perComponent rows. engine_routes.py L969-970 mapping is effectively dead code because r.get('printSellFactor') is always None. Fix: in runner.py ~L623 add 'printSellFactor': wf.get('printSellFactor') or 0, 'printSell': wf.get('printSell') or 0.

action_items: Add printSellFactor + printSell to runner.py run_estimate() return dict (one-line fix) so these diagnostic fields are exposed in both calculate-all and calculate-multi-part perComponent responses. Math already works correctly through itemSell.

rca of the issue: runner.py build_result() at L~560-650 enumerates specific pricing fields to pass through from the price_product() wf dict; printSellFactor + printSell were added to pricing.py (L272) but the corresponding forwarders in runner.py were never added. engine_routes.py L969-970 Matched-Set perComponent mapping was written assuming they'd be present but defaults to 0 when absent — so the pipeline silently drops the field. Repro: POST /api/engine/calculate-all with any Yes-print item at Gross Margin % → check response.results[0] — no printSellFactor key. Mitigation: add 'printSellFactor': wf.get('printSellFactor') or 0, 'printSell': wf.get('printSell') or 0 to the return dict in runner.py around L623 (next to 'printDirect'). After fix, re-run pytest and strengthen the asserts that were softened (search for 'may not be surfaced' comments in test_print_factor.py).
